rationale: C24 and C01 share the conventional opening formula for transmitting a supplemental appropriation estimate to Congress, and C07 uses a related budget-transmittal formula. Those similarities are routine administrative boilerplate inherent in this document type. None supplies the child’s distinctive sequence concerning preliminary inspections, an initial investigative appropriation, evacuation of the Executive Mansion, engineering findings, preservation of its historic character, projected renovation costs, safety considerations, and the requested timetable. No candidate therefore plausibly provided a concrete and material drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation for the fiscal year 1949 in the amount of $5,400,000, for the Federal Works Agency.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have the honor to submit herewith for the consideration of the Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation for the fiscal year 1948 in the amount of $4,245,000,000 for expenses of the European recovery program.
shared_material.explanation: C24 is the closest verbal parallel, but this is a standard appropriation-transmittal sentence with substituted fiscal year, amount, and purpose.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation for the fiscal year 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation in the amount of $2,434,441,000 for the fiscal year 1949
shared_material.explanation: C01 shares nearly identical routine framing for a supplemental appropriation request, but not the child’s substantive argument or organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope, therefore, that early action will be taken on this recommendation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Detailed appropriation requests for these additional amounts are in preparation by the National Military Establishment and will soon be submitted to the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: C07 concerns congressional submission of fiscal-year appropriations and urges action, but the overlap is generic and does not reproduce the child’s administrative or factual machinery.
